description:
-- Landing Pad Sept S --

Special thanks to 忌鲨 for providing the basic structure.

Starts accepting Titanium and Blast Compound when either drops below 100
Impact Reactors will start during power deficit once total current + predicted stored power reaches 30000
Minimum absolutely stable FPS: 20 — bridge-free chained design with improved low-FPS resistance
Logic includes anti-mixing, pad control, item distribution, and reactor startup control
